# hello_qnx sample project
#
# A minimal QNX 8.0 project that `qnxkit check` audits end to end:
# a CMakeLists.txt, a QNX message-passing program (src/main.c), a
# QNX toolchain file, and an mkifs image buildfile (generated by
# `qnxkit buildfile new --target qemu-x86_64 --app hello_qnx`).
#
# Build for QNX 8.0 (needs QNX SDP 8.0):
#   cmake -B build -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=toolchain/qnx-toolchain-aarch64le.cmake
#   cmake --build build
#   mkifs image.build hello_qnx.ifs
#   qemu-system-x86_64 -cpu max -smp 1 -display none -kernel hello_qnx.ifs -serial stdio
